requirement.statement: The support runtime SHALL resolve a schema-editor command template against one dispatch-time accepted snapshot, serializable event data and explicit wildcard bindings without performing mutation.

case.given: A valid template using event, value and literal sources
case.when: The resolver runs for one dispatch
case.then: It SHALL produce one validated concrete command from the captured snapshot and SHALL NOT reread mutable host state

case.given: A required source is missing, a path is unsafe, or a wildcard has no concrete binding
case.then: It SHALL return structured diagnostics and SHALL NOT return a partial command

requirement.statement: SchemaEditorSession SHALL project only authoritative snapshots accepted by its scoped ValueHost at the current revision and SHALL never optimistically mutate the accepted value.

case.given: A session dispatches commands to a ValueHost
case.when: The host accepts, rejects, conflicts or returns malformed data
case.then: Only a valid current-revision acceptance SHALL advance the projection

case.given: Multiple requests complete out of order or after session disposal
case.when: Late, duplicate or stale responses arrive
case.then: They SHALL NOT overwrite an already advanced accepted snapshot or notify disposed subscribers

requirement.statement: Schema-editor runtime SHALL resolve ValueHost and session capabilities from typed Scope runtime bindings using stable config ids rather than plan provenance or a global registry.

case.given: Parent and child scopes bind schema-editor host capabilities
case.when: The runtime resolves a host id in each scope
case.then: Existing runtime assembly visibility and override semantics SHALL select the scoped capability without rescanning source documents

requirement.statement: lowerEditorPlan SHALL generate deterministic canonical Halfcode source material containing one schemaEditor.Editor shell atom, an asUnitFqn-validated logical identity, an injectively projected XNL runtime identity and serializable plan/runtime bindings without capturing host or session state.

case.when: It is lowered and loaded through the real source resolver, loader, unit compiler and app runtime
case.then: The runtime SHALL expose an equivalent plan and one shell atom with zero loader/compiler diagnostics

case.given: The same plan and serializable lowering config
case.then: The source bundle SHALL be deterministic and SHALL contain no ValueHost, callback, accepted snapshot, renderer implementation or synthetic loaded bundle

case.given: Canonical logical Unit FQNs containing $ProfileEditor and _dProfileEditor segments
case.when: Lowering projects them into the current XNL Word-compatible runtime identity
case.then: $ SHALL project to _d and _ SHALL project to __ so the two runtime identities remain distinct while the logical identities are preserved

case.given: Two valid EditorPlans with distinct canonical logical Unit FQNs
case.when: Their lowered source maps are mounted in one memory VFS
case.then: The logical-identity-derived source roots SHALL NOT overlap and both bundles SHALL independently pass the real loader/compiler/app-runtime lifecycle

requirement.statement: The schema-editor support capsule SHALL depend on canonical contract/logic/runtime APIs and SHALL NOT own Vue, Element Plus, Flow/XNL mutation, VFS/database persistence or host-specific writers.

case.given: The support schema-editor source graph and package root exports
case.then: The capsule SHALL expose stable root APIs without renderer or host-mutation ownership leakage
